summary: The tag-triggered GitVerse workflow completed successfully and published three signed ABI-specific APKs to the android-v1.0.3 release, without adding binaries to Git.

checks.name: Signed ABI-split Android release build
checks.observation: Flutter produced app-armeabi-v7a-release.apk, app-arm64-v8a-release.apk, and app-x86_64-release.apk using the configured local upload keystore.

checks.name: GitVerse per-file upload size guard
checks.observation: The release workflow rejects any APK over 95,000,000 bytes before upload. Current ABI APK sizes: armeabi-v7a 29,473,851 bytes; arm64-v8a 38,263,261 bytes; x86_64 44,083,034 bytes. All are below the 100 MB GitVerse release asset limit.

checks.name: Universal APK comparison
checks.observation: The existing universal app-release.apk is 107,753,250 bytes, so it cannot be attached as one GitVerse release asset.

checks.name: Tag-triggered GitVerse Release build and upload
checks.observation: The Windows runner completed the signed split-ABI release build and publication. Public release page lists BOOHTACORD-android-v1.0.3-arm64-v8a.apk (36.5 MiB), BOOHTACORD-android-v1.0.3-armeabi-v7a.apk (28.1 MiB), and BOOHTACORD-android-v1.0.3-x86_64.apk (42 MiB).

remaining: Install the appropriate ABI APK on a physical Android device and complete device acceptance; this evidence verifies build and public release assets, not runtime behavior.
